local_adjustments: Family-aware DNS guard called at native startup, and owned DNS cleanup on native stop
Default stopped on first boot after flashing; boot and config reload respect stopped state; no automatic policy presets; LuCI controls persist autostart state
Service status uses actual procd processes instead of writable state directories; status RPC uses read-only initialization
DNS rules precede WAN marks; migrate only ledger-owned legacy rules
Recover missing PPP IPv4 table defaults on startup/interface events only
Do not cache blackhole/unreachable sticky marks; synchronize snapshot routes with replace

Refresh only reads status; applying settings preserves stopped state
